overview: A college student discovery app where students can create profiles with their home state and city, then discover and connect with peers from the same background. Features dynamic filtering, state-based recommendations, and a modern card-based UI.
features: Internet Identity authentication with session persistence
Profile creation with nickname, state, city, branch, year, interests, and contact
Discover page with dynamic filters by state, city, branch, and year
People from Your State — auto-detected section at the top
Loading skeletons and clean empty states
Mobile-responsive card layout with Connect button
Simple navbar with Home, Discover, and Profile links
